|translation='''Title:''' Stop Motion.

'''Card text:'''
Target a creature vehicle at any marker location. Draw destiny. If that location is under nighttime conditions, add 2 to destiny. A tauntaun is lost if total destiny exceeds 5. Any other creature vehicle is lost if total destiny exceeds 3.

'''Lore:'''
The tauntaun will freeze before you reach the first marker.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese uses マーカー位置 for marker site and 乗用生物 for creature vehicle.
